name: Cook Friends! [❄️]
desc:
Your friends hurt you a lot, and to take revenge on them, you couldn't think of anything better than to cook them and feed the people of your city.

But of course your friends don't like that they become food and want to escape from you, don't let them do it! 

Cook and Fun! And don't let your friends escape.
